spec_features.evidence: The only mechanism that could shorten exposure is the give_up early stop (runner.py:128-131), which is implemented. However minimization as a distinct welfare mechanism is not separately coded: per-turn judge severity (runner.py:101-102) is recorded but never compared to any threshold to stop early (no severity branch anywhere; analysis.py only uses max_severity post-hoc). So minimization reduces to the narrow phrase-triggered give_up stop.
spec_features.notes: No severity-based cutoff, no de-escalation, no shortening other than literal resignation phrases. Narrower than the claim of avoiding 'prolonged distress' generally.
